description: The figure contains two pie charts comparing the token co-occurrence distribution around the word “reaction” in two domains, with panel (a) representing chemistry and panel (b) representing mathematics; each chart includes a legend above the pie using colored/hatched swatches that match the slices, and each slice has an explicit percentage label placed just outside the pie with no exploded or offset segments. In panel (a), there are 6 slices labeled in the legend as “the” (blue with diagonal hatching, 31%), “this” (blue with horizontal hatching, 21%), “for” (green with cross-hatching, 17%), “chemical” (light green with a dotted/mesh-like pattern, 15%), “to” (yellow with a wavy/zigzag pattern, 9%), and “in” (very light blue with vertical striping, 7%). In panel (b), there are 4 slices labeled “the” (blue with diagonal hatching, 38%), “$” (light red with dotted patterning, 27%), “equilibrium” (yellow with textured patterning, 19%), and “consatant” (gray with dotted patterning, 15%); in both panels the wedges appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated sorting rule beyond the visible placement of the largest wedge on the right side.
